group.label: Documentation
group.comment: Ground the assistant on Magento admin how-to documentation so it gives correct procedures. Fetched into your database; nothing is bundled.

field.label: Enable documentation grounding
field.comment: When enabled, a cron indexes the docs into the mago_doc table (~5 MB) on the schedule below. For an immediate first index, run bin/magento mago:docs:index --force.

field.label: Source
field.comment: Where the docs repository is hosted and how it is accessed. Public repositories need no credentials. Choose GitHub App to index a private GitHub repository: create a GitHub App with Contents: read-only, install it on the repo, then fill in the fields below.

field.label: Create a GitHub App
field.comment: One-click setup: creates the App on GitHub with the right permissions and fills in the App ID and private key below for you. Or fill them in manually if you already have an App.

field.label: GitHub App ID
field.comment: The numeric App ID from the GitHub App's settings page (not the Client ID).

field.label: GitHub App private key
field.comment: Paste the App's PEM private key (the whole -----BEGIN...-----END----- block). Stored encrypted.

field.label: GitHub App installation ID
field.comment: Optional. Leave blank to auto-discover the installation on the source repository. Set it only to force a specific installation.

field.label: Source repository
field.comment: GitHub owner/repo. Default is the MIT-licensed Mage-OS mirror of Adobe's Commerce Admin docs. Content is Magento/Adobe Commerce documentation, not Mage-OS-specific.

field.label: Source branch / commit
field.comment: Which branch or commit of the source repository above to index (e.g. main). Pin to a commit for reproducible results.

field.label: Describe what the documentation contains
field.comment: Off by default, the assistant is told the docs are the official Magento/Adobe Commerce admin documentation. Turn this on when you point it at your own docs, to tell the assistant what they cover so it knows when to search them.

field.label: Documentation description
field.comment: A short description of what this documentation set covers, e.g. "our internal warehouse and fulfilment runbooks" or "the ACME theme configuration guide". Woven into the assistant's docs_search tool so it searches these docs for the right questions.

field.label: Results per search
field.comment: Max number of documentation pages pulled in as context per search (default 5). Higher = broader but noisier and more costly.

field.label: Sync schedule
field.comment: Cron expression for the re-index job (default 0 4 1 * *, monthly). A no-op sync costs one API call, so raise the frequency if you feed custom docs that change more often.
